headline: Sony isn’t phasing out discs quite as quickly as we thought
summary: Sony is not killing video game discs as quickly as initially reported. A detail about a discmaking plant being repurposed was incorrect. Some disc production will continue past 2028.

headline: Drama swirls around OpenAI’s legendary mathematical milestone
summary: OpenAI claims to have solved the 90-year-old Navier-Stokes mathematical problem. The solution relates to the complex flow of liquids. This announcement has generated significant scientific debate.

headline: Rivian’s Also apologizes for delays in shipping futuristic e-bikes
summary: Rivian's micromobility spinoff, Also, has delayed its TM-B electric bike. Customers are frustrated by the shipping delays. The TM-B features a unique, software-controlled pedal-by-wire system.

headline: Razer’s ANC-equipped gaming headset for PS5 and Xbox is almost $100 off
summary: The Razer BlackShark V3 Pro gaming headset is on sale for $164.99. It features high-end active noise cancellation (ANC). The Xbox version is compatible with PS5, PC, and Nintendo Switch.

headline: One of Street Fighter 2's Original Designers Wants to Rebalance Super Turbo 3 Decades After Its Release
summary: Akira Nishitani, a Street Fighter 2 designer, wants to rebalance Super Street Fighter 2: Turbo. This initiative comes over 30 years after the game's initial release. It aims to revisit classic game mechanics.

headline: Trump Administration Tetris Clone Vanishes from White House Website Days After Launch
summary: The 'Build the Wall' Tetris clone by the Trump Administration has been removed. It vanished from the White House website less than a week after launch. The game's quick disappearance followed its controversial debut.

headline: The Thin and Light Gigabyte AERO X16 16" RTX 5070 Gaming Laptop Drops to $1,340 at Best Buy
summary: The Gigabyte AERO X16 16" gaming laptop is now $1,340 at Best Buy. It features an RTX 5070 graphics card in a thin, 4.2-pound design. This deal offers powerful gaming performance in a portable package.

headline: Call of Duty Adds Doom Slayer Skin as Part of New Halloween Update
summary: Call of Duty is adding the iconic Doom Slayer as a playable operator. This new skin arrives with the game's upcoming Halloween event. Players can soon embody the demon-slaying protagonist in-game.

headline: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
summary: The UK imposed sanctions on West Bank settlements, sparking a furious Israeli reaction. Britain's foreign secretary accused settlers of "ethnic cleansing." Israel retaliated by closing the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.

headline: Paul Adams: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
summary: British-Israeli relations have reached their lowest point in decades. This follows London's trade ban on Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. The diplomatic tension signifies a critical moment.

headline: More flight delays expected after hundreds cancelled by air traffic control glitch
summary: Further flight delays are anticipated after widespread cancellations. A technical problem affected the air traffic control provider Nats. Numerous airport departures have been impacted across the UK.

headline: RNLI boss says volunteers facing 'unacceptable' abuse
summary: The RNLI chief says volunteers are enduring "unacceptable" abuse. He attributes this to "deliberate misinformation" spread about the charity. The RNLI is appealing for an end to the harassment of its crews.
